name: link
title: Link
purpose: Navigate to another location with consistent Balsa styling and safe external-link behavior.
avoidFor: Actions that do not change location
Icon-only links without an accessible name
accessibility: External links receive a new browsing context and noreferrer protection.
Icon-only usage requires the label prop.
commonMistakes: Using Link for an in-place action.
Omitting a useful accessible name from an icon-only link.
Adding a theme-specific glass variant instead of allowing outline to inherit the Glassmorphism material recipe.

composition.neutralColor: Neutral is the chrome color: a filled neutral action uses the inverse pair and every quieter treatment resolves to the plain foreground, so toolbar and shell controls do not compete with the content they frame.
